checks.assessment: Two high and sixteen moderate package entries. Electron GHSA-jr5w-w6x2-84p9 concerns compromised eMudhra intermediate certificate mitigation and affects the pinned binary range; it is not merely a build-tool finding. Other entries include undici and build-chain findings. The zero production-only npm count excludes Electron and must not be used to declare the installer unaffected. Upstream updates are reported available; publication of the unchanged baseline was explicitly selected by the release requester after disclosure, not as a security remediation.
